headline: Midnight arrives, the lamp stays.
body: The window glass has gone black. A moth still circles the bulb, wings ticking against it once every few seconds. The city outside has thinned to a single set of footsteps that fade.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: clear, faint stars above the roofs

pulses.label: Light
pulses.value: lamp warm, moth shadow on the page

pulses.label: Street
pulses.value: empty, one set of footsteps fading
